scenicChapters.title: Bieszczady Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 17 km this is Bieszczady Loop, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-border-ridge-and-gorna-solinka-va.story: A 69 km round trip from Lutowiska - roughly 1 h 11 in the saddle. The stops in between: Wolosatka stream valley, Uzhok-Tserkva of the Synaxis of the Archan and back through Wolosatka stream valley. It crosses from Poland into Ukraine - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. Rivers set the line for much of the day.
